name: Concord of Lanterns
description: A loose league of lantern-lit worlds that keeps the lanes safe and the paperwork light.

name: Independent Settlements
description: Frontier holdings that answer to no one and share what they have with any pilot who comes in peace.

name: Free Reach Compact
description: A compact of traders and prospectors on the far rim, bound by handshake contracts.

name: Unlit Holdings
description: Settlers of the Dimming who keep their own lamps low and their own counsel. They owe the old charts nothing and the Concord less.

name: Rimward Raiders
description: Hard-up crews who work the lonely lanes and take what they can from the ships that pass.
